dataset_asset.terms_summary: The pinned Silicon Labs archive supplies the 96 by 96 COCO-derived images, and the pinned EEMBC index selects the balanced 1,000-example MLPerf Tiny accuracy set.

dataset_source: Pinned MLPerf Tiny 1,000-example accuracy set derived from the Visual Wake Words COCO 2014 corpus

measurement_protocol.device_synchronization: synchronize immediately before and after the measured inference region
excluded_phases: asset fetching and exact accuracy-set selection
JPEG decoding and RGB float32 normalization
TFLite weight parsing and PyTorch model construction
one shape warmup for each observed batch shape
measurement_protocol.timing_scope: 50 repetitions of the complete 1,000-example accuracy set after model, data, and five complete-set warmup passes are ready

public.rationale: Direct MLPerf Tiny MobileNetV1 and balanced 1,000-example accuracy-contract adaptation; claims remain withheld until a committed five-run sweep is complete.

reviewer_notes: The 80% threshold, MobileNet task, and 1,000-example balanced accuracy contract are inherited from MLPerf Tiny.
Promotion requires committed five-run timing evidence and independent review of the TFLite-to-PyTorch adapter.
Each execution performs five untimed complete accuracy-set passes, then measures 50 unchanged passes; quality is computed from the first measured pass only.

target_source.rationale: The 80% threshold, MobileNet task, and 1,000-example balanced accuracy contract are inherited from MLPerf Tiny.
